referee_caveats_inferred: A single epoch of ALMA; the radio-quiet interpretation rests on a ratio compared with AGN SEDs, which is not well justified for X-ray binaries
Observations are not strictly simultaneous (NICER ~3 h later; UVOT a day later)
Extrapolating the mm flux to 5 GHz assumes the same power law with no turnover
Flux uncertainties and calibration systematics are not propagated into luminosities
Background rms of 3–8 mJy/beam is comparable to source flux, implying low S/N for flux densities
